# Sable Gives Oren the Sealed Letter

Under the gate tower, Sable passes Oren a warm wax-sealed letter and says only, “Heron rule.” Oren recognizes the contingency phrase and does not place the letter inside his satchel.

Mara has no knowledge of this event at the active scene.
